title: Tidewell sales pitch (fictional company, example data)

brief.motion: Product launch: warm canvas, springy UI reveals with a small overshoot, a cursor that acts, crisp counters. Camera eases in towards whatever is being said.
brief.story: A plain sales deck becomes a product launch film for a fictional helpdesk tool. Opens on a dark overflowing inbox (the pain), turns light for the product, ends on a bold result.

scenes.narration: Your support inbox never sleeps. Neither does Tidewell.

slide.notes: Your support inbox never sleeps. Neither does Tidewell.

scenes.storyboard: night stage, a phone-style notification stack keeps arriving and piling up. On 'Neither' a wave of teal light sweeps through, the notifications fold away and the Tidewell wordmark forms.

scenes.narration: Tickets pile up overnight, and customers wait hours for a first reply. Meanwhile, your team answers the same five questions again and again.
